India's extreme poverty has fallen from 27.1% in 2011 to just 2.6% in 2023, according to the World Bank's October 2026 India Poverty and Equity Brief. An estimated 496 million Indians have moved above the $4.20-a-day poverty line. But does this mean India is no longer poor?
In this episode of The Lallantop's Kharcha Pani, we break down the World Bank India Poverty Report 2026 and explain what these numbers actually mean for ordinary Indians.
